scientific_integrity: The universal bound is an analytic great-circle Fourier argument with an exact equality witness. The convexity threshold follows from the exact operator norm and the support-function curvature criterion; endpoint arithmetic is independently replayable. No numerical sampling is used for an infinite or continuum assertion.
scientific_limitations: The sharp universal estimate is proved only for degree-three spherical harmonics. The exact convexity-radius application treats the \(q_+\) axis of the source harmonic plane, not arbitrary linear combinations and not the global feasible-region extremal problem.
title: Sharp cubic-harmonic curvature bound and the exact positive Wigner radius
